name: Storm-hair
description: The Unknown Regions warlike species known to the insectoid Quesoth as the Storm-hairs emerged from an Unknown Regions planet, led by the brutal Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva, and ravaged Unknown Regions and Wild Space. By 0 ABY, Nuso Esva's realm had expanded its reign—considered a reign of terror—to the Galactic Empire's fringes.
